development_exposure: Original sub-01/ses-01 validation diagnostic exposed before this amendment; not initial preregistration
proposal: unchanged bootstrap prior transition; systematic resampling; log-space weights; instrument ESS/max-weight/stability
variance_reduction: Systematic resampling retained. Independent repetitions diagnose single-run variability, not an ensemble mean endpoint. Antithetics/observation-guided proposal not introduced without correction/oracle validation.
reference_uncertainty: max trial abs(high-reference mean minus low-reference mean) plus1.96 high-reference replicate SD/sqrt(8)
single_run_discrepancy: max over trials of max over candidate replicas abs(replica minus high-reference mean) plus1.96 candidate replicate SD plus reference uncertainty
selection: Evaluate every prescribed budget; least budget satisfying both reference and single-run discrepancy<=0.001. Endpoint always first prespecified candidate seed, never best replica or mean.
bias_audit: Report candidate mean-minus-reference and replicate SD per trial at every budget, reference budget shift. Log of nonnegative likelihood estimate has Jensen bias; repetitions/budget agreement cannot prove absolute accuracy.
fairness: Exact HMM without MC error; identical candidate/reference budgets,seeds,repetitions,threshold for all continuous/hybrid dimensions/states; original training grid,seeds,covariates,convergence and complexity policy unchanged.
compute: 1 BLAS thread; record wall time per budget/reference and training; stream trials/replicas without storing particle trajectories. Maximum selected8192, reference32768. No budget reduction to obtain PASS.
failure: Any nonconverged required seed or failed integration diagnostic stops; INCONCLUSIVE, no holdout.
warnings: Five prior warnings are incomplete R05/R06/R07/R08/R13, not five known code bugs; each remains open until its scientific evidence exists.
